consultation_mode.description: Review mode for this consultation response. Independent of the separate coverage_claim.

material_change.description: Set true when a new reply materially changes jurisdiction roles, proceedings/stage, legal question, urgency, requested output, issue/check selection, source use, module use, or execution. This makes a fresh full dashboard mandatory even without a new explicit invocation.

affected_scope_refs.description: Opaque consultation scopes whose prior review state is invalidated by the material change.

reassessed_scope_refs.description: Affected scopes re-reviewed for this response. Any affected scope omitted here remains open and blocks comprehensive coverage.

response_tracking.description: The local route gate accepts model_declared or unavailable. runtime_recorded is reserved for a host that validates its own authenticated read event; the plugin gate rejects that value.

conversation_tracking.description: The local route gate accepts model_declared or unavailable. runtime_recorded is reserved for a host that validates its own authenticated read event; the plugin gate rejects that value.

response_discovery_method.description: How this source record was identified for the current response. Model-reported; not a host-authenticated retrieval event. Use not_applicable only when response_use is not_referenced.

conversation_discovery_method.description: How this source record was identified earlier in the conversation. Model-reported; not a host-authenticated retrieval event. Use not_applicable only when conversation_use is not_referenced.

response_provenance.description: The local route gate accepts model_declared or none. runtime_recorded is reserved for a host that validates its own authenticated read event; the plugin gate rejects that value.

conversation_provenance.description: The local route gate accepts model_declared or none. runtime_recorded is reserved for a host that validates its own authenticated read event; the plugin gate rejects that value.

adverse_predicate_states.description: Topic-specific adverse conditions; route trigger signals are not substitutes.

record_scope.description: For material-revision reconciliation, declares whether this evidence was reviewed or generated for the current response. This field is not a trusted runtime timestamp.
